what: The big intro sentence is split into words set in a faded color, word i takes its own color in .2s cubic-bezier(.11,0,.5,0) the moment the spot at ‹sentence top + sentence height ÷ word count × i› passes the screen center — scrolling down lights words one after another from the first, and scrolling back up turns them off again at the same spot (switched on and off with no scroll-tied in-between values)

options.speed: Multiplier for spacing between trigger points, default 1 — smaller turns everything on within a shorter scroll
options.once: if true, it stays on even when scrolled back up

use: Your intro sentence here in two lines
note: Rewriting text into word spans removes inner styling (bold · links) — the original also rewrites via innerText. Removing it restores the original HTML

from.where: index.html big team About sentence (original .articleTextLarge scrubTextReveal split-by word · effect color)
